messages:
alex: Quick UX review from the playtest — streaming feels jumpy when you hit Stop mid-word. attached GIF: https://img.redwood/mock/gif1.gif maria: Oof yeah I see that. Is the renderer chopping and reflowing the message container? can we keep a placeholder skeleton for the remainder of the token row? :thinking_face: devon: We redraw the last message on every token append atm. Suggest only append to inner text node and avoid full message DOM diff while streaming. that should remove layout jumps. sam: Accessibility note: VoiceOver announces the token stream repeatedly. When Stop is pressed, it should announce final state once (aria-live polite) instead of spamming. alex: Good call. Proposed aria snippet:```html
Streaming… 234 tokens
``` Keep updates throttled to 200ms for a11y. maria: On the stop/regenerate affordance — users expect two distinct actions. Current single circular button toggles stop/regen which confuses testers. Can we surface both: a primary Stop (when streaming) and secondary Regenerate after stream ends? devon: Implementation idea: while streaming show [Stop streaming] + tiny [Copy] icon; after stopped replace Stop with [Regenerate] + [Resume streaming] if cached. Resume should reuse KV cache so latency is fast. rachel: Token counter copy: testers thought the counter represented total per-account tokens. We need copy that clarifies scope. Suggest: a small tooltip "Generation tokens — excludes prompt tokens" and show two counters separated by a divider: "Prompt 312 | Generation 24". alex: Agree. Also UX microcopy tweak: change button label from "Stop" to "Stop streaming" on desktop. On mobile keep short icon + accessible label. sam: Mobile layout: in compact narrow widths stack actions vertically; icon-only buttons without labels fail accessibility contrast targets and hit targets. We need minimum 44px and visible label when possible. maria: Prompt library placement: request to show token estimate inline for each prompt card and a "last used" timestamp. That helps users pick low-cost prompts. Also add a small star pin so people can keep favorite prompts at top. devon: One more perf nit: streaming appends are triggering expensive reflow because we compute token meter width on every append. Cache meter width and only recalc on container resize or message boundary. alex: Acceptance criteria request (short): - Streaming stops without container reflow or jump on Stop (visual test on desktop and mobile) - VoiceOver reads final state exactly once after stopping (a11y test) - Two counters visible: Prompt | Generation with tooltip explaining scope (copy reviewed by content) - Stop + Regenerate are distinct affordances; Resume leverages cached KV to avoid full regen latency - Prompt library cards show token estimate and last-used sort option maria: Linking the current prototype so folks can poke: https://figma.redwood/playground-stream-v7 (see frames 12–15 for streaming states) :link: ui-bot: deploy-preview created for branch playground/stream-stability — preview: https://preview.redwood/stream-stability (auto-uploaded screenshots included) :tada: alex: I'll consolidate notes into the PR description and add the acceptance criteria as checklist. tagging @devon @maria for implementation design. :thumbsup: rachel: tiny copy suggestion for tooltip: replace 'Generation tokens' with 'Response tokens (generated by model)' — clearer for support docs. alex: Love that. I'll make the copy tweak and ping content for signoff. We'll follow up with a short QA checklist and rollout plan.
